log_requirements_summary: Customer requires structured, machine-readable audit logs for every inference request and system event. Logs must be exportable to their Splunk instance in near real-time, optionally via syslog/TCP forwarder or batched S3 export. Logs cannot contain unredacted PII; sensitive fields must be hashed or redacted before export. KMS-managed encryption of logs at-rest and envelope encryption on the log forwarding path required. Retention policy is regulatory: 2 years for event-level telemetry, 7 years for auth/access logs. All fallback and routing decisions must be recorded with unique request IDs for traceability.
siem_export_formats: S3 parquet/json sink for batch ingestion
retention_policy: Event telemetry: 2 years; Authentication & access logs: 7 years. Customer wants SLA for timely deletion on request for scoped data subjects in region-specific stores.
access_log_requirements: Include admin console access events (user, action, timestamp)
Record API key usage with request_id and caller IP
Log failed auth attempts and MFA events separately
Immutable append-only storage for access logs with WORM flag if possible
